title: Prohibiting Electric Bicycles in Designated Areas in Toa Payoh East-Novena
what_it_is: Prohibiting Electric Bicycles in Designated Areas in Toa Payoh East-Novena

sections.label: Electric bicycles and elderly safety
sections.summary: Asked whether electric bicycles will be banned on pedestrian walks and crossings in Toa Payoh East-Novena for elderly and child safety, with fines and tightened LTA rules.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: asked 	the Minister for Transport in view of the increasing number of elderly living in Toa Payoh East-Novena who are less mobile and have poorer eyesight whether the Ministry will consider prohibiting the use of electric bicycles on designated pedestrian walks and traffic light crossings in Toa Payoh East-Novena for the safety of the elderly and young children.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Those caught riding on pedestrian footpaths will be fined.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: For everyone's safety, LTA had tightened the technical requirements for electric bicycles in December last year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Only electric bicycles which weigh less than 20 kilogrammes and the motor power cut off as they reach speeds of 25 kilometres per hour or, if the cyclist stops pedalling, are allowed on public roads.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA has also stepped up enforcement and penalties against electric bicycles that do not comply with these requirements.

sections.label: Review by Faishal Ibrahim
sections.summary: A comprehensive review by Parliamentary Secretary Assoc Prof Dr Faishal Ibrahim is in advanced stages and will soon announce findings addressing the Member's points.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: A comprehensive review is currently being undertaken by Parliamentary Secretary Assoc Prof Dr Faishal Ibrahim and I understand that the current discussions are in the advanced stages.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: The review panel will be making its announcement known soon and it will address the different aspects that the Member has raised.
